players.product: photonic fault-tolerant quantum computers; Inception photonic chip manufacturing facility (Toronto, 158,000 sq ft)

quarterly_data.signal: Xanadu 6-K: the CAD $195 million Strategic Response Fund commitment formalizes the complete federal portion of the potential funding of up to CAD $390 million in support for Project OPTIMISM announced on March 11, 2026; Xanadu says the capabilities it develops (advanced photonic packaging, heterogeneous integration, wafer-level test) are also foundational to telecommunications, AI hardware and sensing. CEO Christian Weedbrook: 'We believe building utility-scale quantum computers will require a new generation of highly specialized manufacturing capabilities.'
quarterly_data.figure: CAD $195 million of up to CAD $390 million potential Project OPTIMISM funding
